thread:
IncidentBot: [P1] ALERT runtime-prod: sustained 5xx spike detected for 10m. Pager: @maya oncall. Rule: runtime_5xx_rate > 2.5% (5m). Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/runtime-5xx

maya: i'm on it — thanks bot. anyone seeing obvious deploys or scaling events?

jonah: eu-prod shows a simultaneous bump in 5xx and worker restarts. not sure yet if model oom or gateway timeouts. digging into logs now.

lina: i'll grab traces and tail logs for the problematic routes. we should silence the noisy follow-ups (gateway_* flapping). otherwise we'll get flooded.

maya: agree. silence non-actionable dup alerts. keep core P1 and the data-plane perf ones. 30m silence ok as a starting point.

lina: running silence — command:
```
opsctl silence --selector "alertname=~'gateway_.*_5xx'" --until 1732506121 --comment "incident triage: runtime-prod 5xx spike"
```
output: silence created id=silence-8f2a expires=1732506121

maya: also put a maintenance window in Alertmanager for the cluster so we don't re-page while we triage.

eva: i'll spin up a quick panel in grafana with 5xx by route + p95 latency so we can correlate. will also add a one-click link for silences so ops can see them.

jonah: initial customer impact check — support queue shows ~12 unique customers with timeouts for the last 40m. most recovered on retry. flagging product-ops for comms.

maya: mitigation note: i'm temporarily lowering autoscaler sensitivity on the runtime-worker to reduce oscillation (manual). command used:
```
kubectl -n infra patch hpa runtime-worker --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"behavior":null,"minReplicas":3}}'
```
this is temporary while we stabilize.

lina: copied. setting maintenance window in alertmanager (30m) now.

IncidentBot: handoff scheduled — from maya to lina at 1732505400 (18:30 UTC).

maya: quick triage summary for handoff: likely short-lived backend OOMs causing worker restarts -> upstream timeouts. silences in place for gateway flapping. eva is adding dashboards. jonah is drafting postmortem.

lina: taking over. i'll validate the silences and keep paging on the P1 only. will open an ops ticket for the autoscaler change to document temporary tweak.

jonah: for alert tuning proposal: we should split runtime_5xx_rate into two rules — global endpoints (threshold 1%) and bulk/batch endpoints (threshold 3%). keep evaluation window at 5m but add a 1m grace for known bursty paths. i'll mock a prometheus rule.

jonah: example rule snippet:
```
- alert: runtime_5xx_rate_global
  expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="runtime",route!~"/batch/.*",status=~"5.."}[5m]))
        / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="runtime",route!~"/batch/.*"}[5m])) > 0.01
  for: 5m
```
and a separate one for /batch with >0.03 threshold.

maya: sounds good. but let's validate thresholds before we change prod rules. eva — can you run a replay on staging traffic and estimate false-positive rate if we move to those thresholds?

eva: yes. i'll run: `./scripts/alert_replay.py --rule runtime_5xx_rate --env staging --thresholds 0.01,0.03` and post results in this thread. aim to have numbers in 2 hours.

lina: action items from me: open SRE ticket SRE-1987 (alert rule cleanup), PR for rule changes (w/ replay data), revoke silences after validation, update runbook with new thresholds.

jonah: i'll own the postmortem doc and customer-impact section. maya, can you post the final support/customer counts?

maya: yep — will export support logs and drop numbers into the doc.

eva: follow-up: after we validate thresholds i'll add the new panels to the ops dashboard and create a synthetic check that hits critical endpoints every 5m. that will help us catch regressions without re-alerting on noisy batch jobs.

lina: note on maintenance windows — don't forget to schedule proper end times and to remove them once we've validated. we shouldn't leave long silences.

maya: post-incident cleanup checklist (short):
  1) remove temporary silences/maintenance windows once replay/validation passes
  2) merge PR for alert rule split + thresholds with replay metrics attached
  3) add dashboard panels and synthetic monitors to the runbook
  4) schedule a 30m follow-up sync in 24h to review metrics after rollback removal

jonah: adding product-ops and support leads to postmortem once draft is ready.

IncidentBot: silence id=silence-8f2a created by lina expires=1732506121 (30m).

lina: updating SRE-1987 with links: runbook, silence id, grafana dashboard. tagging @eva for verification steps.

maya: handing off now — lina has the page. i'm stepping offline in 10. thanks all. :pray:

lina: acknowledged. i'll keep this thread live and post verification results.

eva: replay started — ETA ~1h30. posting numbers later.

jonah: drafting postmortem, will reference this thread for timeline and actions.

lina: final note before last_message_ts: silences in place, autoscaler tweak documented in SRE ticket, dashboards in progress. planning to remove silences after eva posts replay numbers.

maya: thanks team.
